after.description: Only return entries at or after this ISO 8601 timestamp. The results never extend outside the recording's own start and end time.

before.description: Only return entries at or before this ISO 8601 timestamp. The results never extend outside the recording's own start and end time.

id.description: A UUID string identifying this session recording.

level.description:
Only return entries at this level. Omit to return every level.

* `info` - Info
* `warn` - Warn
* `error` - Error

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-500, default 100).

offset.description: Number of entries to skip. Use with `limit` to page through a long recording.
